questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the given sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

If India will win this match they will win the series
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**if India will win'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ​In the given context, the main clause is in **'simple future tense' **
 
• Thus, 'If clause' will be in present tense;** **i.e. **'will win'** will be replaced with** 'wins'**
 
• The given context is a conditional sentence The structure of the conditional sentence is- If + Simple Present, Simple Future
 
• In such sentences 'If clause' will be in simple present tense and the 'main clause' in simple future tense
 
 
• Let's see the example:
 
 
• If I will come to Lucknow, I will meet you. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09ba30f4e6b45efbf6efb4aec329630445ea9002ab2a7ae3b2029f9c47aef72.png] 
 
• If I come to Lucknow, I will meet you. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dae7bbdb971caf2f64cde2bd084f0e6b0ca813705f12836f1d1a8d634a4412f.png] 

 
 
 
 
 

*Hence the correct sentence is-* *If India **wins **this match they will win the series.*

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. He put it down to dry and went to count his coins.

B. When he came back, it seemed like the teapot had moved.

C. Akito walked into an old curiosity shop and bought a teapot and took it home.

D. Later that day, he cleaned the teapot till it shone like the sun.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CDAB'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage should begin with a sentence that introduces the subject under consideration.
 
 
• This is done by sentence C, which introduces us to a person who buys a teapot. So, sentence C becomes the first sentence.
 
 
 
• From the remaining sentences it is clear that the person's interactions with the teapot are listed. 
 
 
• So, sentence D, which talks about how he cleaned the teapot should become the second sentence. 
 
 
 
• Sentence A that talks about how he kept it down to dry becomes the third sentence. This sentence also talks about how he went away after that to count his money.
 
• His view about the teapot after he came back as told in sentence A, becomes the fourth sentence.

questions.question:
**Select the option that is the direct form of the given sentence.**

Brinda told her doctor that she was leaving for Boston the next day.

options.text: Brinda told to her doctor, “I will be leaving for Boston the next day”.
Brinda told her doctor, “I was leaving for Boston tomorrow”.
Brinda said to her doctor, “I am leaving for Boston tomorrow.”
Brinda had told her doctor, “She was leaving for Boston the next day”.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'​Brinda said to her doctor, “I am leaving for Boston tomorrow.”'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** **The given sentence is in **indirect form.**
 
• To change it to direct form, we need to do the following - 
 
 
• Change in pronoun - In direct speech the pronoun changes to first person. So, **'she' will become 'I'.**
 
• Change in statement sentence - In direct speech, the 'told' is converted either to 'said' or remains the same. So, it either remains '**told' or becomes 'said'.**
 
• Change in tense - The **past continuous tense (was leaving) **in the indirect speech changes to **present continuous tense (am leaving)** in direct speech.
 
 
 
• Only **option 3** covers all three changes making it the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Select the option that is the passive form of the given sentence.**

She did not forget me even though I have been away for a year.

options.text: I was not forgotten by her even though I have been away for a year.
Even though I have been away for a year she had not been forgotten.
Even though I have been away for a year she did not forget me.
Though I have been away for a year she has not forgot me.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**I was not forgotten by her even though I have been away for a year.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an **assertive** sentence.
 
• We need to follow these instructions while changing the voice of an assertive sentence.
 
 
• Find the subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well if subject and object are pronouns.
 
• In the given sentence the subject is '**s****he**,' while the object is ‘**I**’.
 
• Use preposition **'by' **before agent '**she'.**
 
 

Following these steps, we finally get - "I was not forgotten by her even though I have been away for a year."

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the given sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

I don’t recognize none of the politicians who have been invited to be the speakers today.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**I don’t recognize none of**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let's look at the following points-

__
 
• **'Any' **is used for negative and Interrogative sentences respectively

 
 
• **For e.g.-** The Government has annexed specimen orders which **do not** provide **any** clear reasons for their issuance.
 
 
 
• Since the given sentence is a negative sentence, **none** will be replaced with **any**
 
• The correct word to be used here is** 'any'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• None denotes **'not one' or 'not any'. **
 
• **None of is not used** when there is already a negative word (not, n’t) in the clause
 
• For e.g.-They didn't invite none of us. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1a87ad92ad303243bc5bdadf0298ce0c1be793ca00a243c705b24271abc17ec.png] 

 They didn't invite any of us. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1180797d2c6c42eca4dcce3c0aa4ad06d26d2eac3d040336c1254c66685aee9e.png] ​
